0022600206.text: The Raptors (4-4, 2-1 at home) sit 7th in the East and 3 games back in the Atlantic after a loss, while the Grizzlies (6-2, 4-0 on the road) are 5th in the West and 0.5 games back in the Southwest after a two-game losing streak. Toronto is missing Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), and Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Raptors won 2-0 in the 2025-26 season series and beat the Grizzlies 128-96 in their last meeting, on April 3, 2026, in Memphis.
